hypothesis: Entry drift starts at 3-6s, before old branch roots; full student-visited trajectories improve feedback recovery
teacher_limit: Modified teacher is not certified: new-seed mild clean 81/96 and harsh not solved

sources.common: clean teacher episodes from new collection plus 60 old clean episodes relabeled with same corrected teacher
sources.teacher_only: second batch drawn from same teacher pool
sources.full_dagger: second batch from full acting-student episodes

actor_during_collection: fixed initial checkpoint; no teacher intervention
query_mask: margin at capture >=-3cm, distance to reference <=12cm, heading difference <=60deg; additionally existing done-margin mask
supervision: These are oracle queries, not claims that every query leads to a clean recovery. Failure originals retained.

training.source_mix: 0.5 common teacher + 0.5 second source, each four episodes one per movement
training.objective: equal-episode turn-weighted SmoothL1 beta .05; no preference term
training.selection: use fixed final update 1200, no checkpoint selection by observed driving

evaluation: same frozen local development matrix 4101/4102 x three vehicles x four movements x three conditions; NOT final exam
